title: Registry review accepts an exterior-only building whose record gains confirmed citations; the cited card
cause: registry.ts evidenceChecks parsed every combined record with recordBodySchema (footprint of 3+ points, no
representation key). registryReviewInputs leaves current exterior-only records out, but the proposed one (the
same recorded building with its new register-row citation) stayed in, so prepareRegistryReview threw a ZodError
and the intake run stopped at stage 3 with INTAKE_RUN_INPUT. Two more places would have refused it next: the geo
check payload (a record footprint of [] is not a polygon) and the commit's ST_GeomFromGeoJSON of an empty ring.

cause: registryBodySchema widened for any proposed record with revision > 0 that was exterior-only,
so a correction turning a recorded polygon building into footprint [] + physical_exterior passed
and commit wrote a null footprint.
fix: registry.ts currentExteriorIds(current) collects the ids of current exterior-only records.
evidenceChecks takes that set; keepsExterior(record, exteriors) picks exteriorRecordBodySchema only when
the current record with the same id and the proposal are both exterior-only; else recordBodySchema.
prepareRegistryReview, persistRegistryReviewTx and commitRegistryReviewTx pass the set; commit writes a
null footprint only under keepsExterior, so it never nulls one the current record has.
